description:
Vikisol Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a global technology consulting and workforce solutions company helping enterprises modernize across SAP, cloud, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, managed services, and digital transformation.

We also support customer experience, commerce, supply chain, finance, learning, sustainability, and talent programs so clients can work with one partner across the full enterprise landscape. Founded in 2021 and headquartered at Mindspace, Hyderabad, Vikisol has become a trusted delivery partner for businesses across India, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, the USA, the UK, and Australia.

With 100+ projects delivered and 500+ consultants deployed, we combine specialist execution with the mindset of a consulting firm that understands scale, governance, and outcomes.
subtitle: Trusted by enterprises for SAP, AI, cloud, cybersecurity, software, and workforce solutions.
